evals.prompt: Create an automated product demo for a healthcare company evaluating our Corporate Training Module. They train 200 nurses annually and want to reduce onboarding time by 40%.
evals.expected_output: A personalized demo script with prospect-specific value metrics, ROI calculations based on 200 nurses and 40% time reduction, and key decision points.
assertions: Response creates a demo flow personalized to nursing onboarding use case
Response includes ROI calculation specific to 200 nurses and 40% time reduction target
Response addresses prospect pain points rather than generic feature listing

evals.prompt: Build an ROI calculator for our Skills Assessment Platform. An HR department spends €50K/year on external assessments for 500 employees. Show the savings with NEXUS.
evals.expected_output: An ROI calculator with current cost breakdown, NEXUS pricing, projected savings, payback period, and additional qualitative benefits.
assertions: Response provides a clear cost comparison between current spend and NEXUS solution
Response calculates specific savings amount and payback period
Response includes qualitative benefits beyond direct cost savings

evals.prompt: Design an automated follow-up sequence for leads who attended a demo but have not converted after 2 weeks. Include 5 touchpoints with progressive value content.
evals.expected_output: A 5-touchpoint follow-up sequence with timing, content theme, channel, and call-to-action for each touchpoint.
assertions: Response includes exactly 5 touchpoints with specific timing between each
Response provides distinct value-adding content for each touchpoint, not just reminders
Response includes clear call-to-action progression toward conversion

evals.prompt: Generate a technical proposal for a school district with 15 schools and 8,000 students. They need AI tutoring in math and science with LMS integration. Include pricing and timeline.
evals.expected_output: A technical proposal with solution architecture, implementation timeline, pricing for 15 schools, integration plan, and expected student outcome improvements.
assertions: Response includes a solution description tailored to math/science AI tutoring at scale
Response provides pricing structured for a 15-school district deployment
Response includes implementation timeline with phases and milestones

evals.prompt: Design a sales pipeline automation for our White-Label Agent Factory targeting enterprise buyers. Define pipeline stages, qualification criteria, and conversion benchmarks.
evals.expected_output: A pipeline design with stage definitions, qualification criteria (BANT/MEDDIC), expected conversion rates per stage, and automation triggers.
assertions: Response defines at least 5 pipeline stages with clear entry/exit criteria
Response includes qualification framework (BANT, MEDDIC, or similar)
Response provides conversion rate benchmarks per stage with automation triggers

should_trigger: Create a personalized demo for a healthcare prospect
Build an ROI calculator for our assessment platform
Design a follow-up sequence for post-demo leads
Generate a technical proposal for a school district
should_not_trigger: What is our brand positioning in the EdTech market?
Design a community building strategy for educators
Evaluate the legal compliance of our AI products
Build a patient case simulation for medical students
Analyze investment trends in AI education
